body: DM-519 attempt4 investigation: an actual App/installed-xterm consumer regression and the native same-cell return expose xterm6.0 hover-cache failure. Independent source review confirms mouseleave does not reset _lastBufferCell; identical-cell mousemove skips _handleHover; clearing the current link removes its render listener. Public refresh/provider re-registration/repeated replies cannot provide a supported reset. Official stable remains6.0.0; worker read-only comparison reports6.1.0-beta.337 has the same defect (no beta code executed or installed). The failed public-reply/URI-fence prototype is not accepted or integrated; its negative evidence is being preserved and verified source restored. A version-pinned tracked upstream cache fix is a proposed remedy, NOT verified or authorized. Explicit user permission for the saved-plan no-vendor-patch exception has been requested and remains pending. w4 is not met; cross-row screenshots are not exact-cell recovery. Physical SetCursorPos denial and the final Windows/native/clipboard/PTY/provider/DoD matrix are separate outstanding obligations. No macOS or final-product pass claimed.
